THE PLAYBOOK STARTS HERE

Own the offense.

Offense and defense are random each rep by default. Choose a specific play to repeat it. Select Move the chains in settings to track downs and distance. Read the defense and snap. You control the quarterback, then the ball carrier after a catch or handoff. Every defender is controlled by the CPU.

Controller & touch

Standard gamepad: left stick to move, right trigger to sprint. A snaps the ball. After the snap, A / X / Y / B / RB pass to receivers 1–5. D-pad left/right jukes; Back changes camera; Start pauses.

On touch devices, use the left movement pad, receiver buttons and the sprint button. Landscape gives you a wider view.

Pre-snap adjustments

Press H on a passing play, choose receiver 1–5, then select a route. Press Z to change the entire play for this snap. The route art updates to match.

Make the read

Set your feet for accuracy. Pressure and throwing on the move widen the pass error. Lead into space. Crossing the line of scrimmage commits you to a run.

On run plays, the handoff is automatic. On play action, the fake takes about one second before you can release.
